description: Formal style contract between @wabou/vite and the GPUI-CE projection. Every compiler-emitted property maps losslessly to GPUI Style or explicit Wabou node metadata; everything else is a compile error.

unsupported.box-sizing: GPUI owns box layout and does not expose a selectable CSS box model.
unsupported.contain: GPUI does not expose CSS containment as a style property.
unsupported.flex: Use the explicit flex-grow, flex-shrink and flex-basis fields projected by GPUI.
unsupported.grid-auto-flow: The formal GPUI grid subset requires explicit templates and placements.
unsupported.grid-template: Use GPUI grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows explicitly.
unsupported.grid-template-areas: GPUI does not expose named grid areas.
unsupported.justify-items: GPUI Style does not expose justify-items.
unsupported.justify-self: GPUI Style does not expose justify-self.
unsupported.border-style: Only solid borders are implemented; style keywords have no host mapping.
unsupported.text-decoration: Text decoration painting is not implemented.
unsupported.text-decoration-line: Text decoration painting is not implemented.
unsupported.outline: GPUI Style does not expose production outlines; use borders or a dedicated focus-ring component.
unsupported.outline-color: GPUI Style does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.outline-offset: GPUI Style does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.outline-style: GPUI Style does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.outline-width: GPUI Style does not expose production outlines.
unsupported.list-style-type: List marker painting is not implemented.
unsupported.transition: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.
unsupported.animation: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.
unsupported.transform: Use the explicit runtime transform opcode; GPUI Style has no CSS transform field.
unsupported.transform-component: Use the explicit runtime transform opcode.
unsupported.transform-origin-x: GPUI Style has no CSS transform-origin field.
unsupported.transform-origin-y: GPUI Style has no CSS transform-origin field.
unsupported.transform-rotate: Use the explicit runtime transform opcode.
unsupported.transform-scale: Use the explicit runtime transform opcode.
unsupported.transform-translate-x: Use the explicit runtime transform opcode.
unsupported.transform-translate-y: Use the explicit runtime transform opcode.
unsupported.user-select: Text selection is an explicit component/input policy in the GPUI runtime.

unsupportedPrefixes.transition-: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.
unsupportedPrefixes.animation-: CSS is stateless; drive runtime transform state from JS or Rust.
